no_adcom_quote.quote: Although this BLA is for a new molecular entity, there is nothing novel about the molecule, there were no concerns regarding the efficacy or safety profiles, and so there was no controversy regarding the approvability of the application. For these reasons, we decided not to take the application to an advisory committee meeting.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the Plegridy (pegylated interferon beta-1a) BLA. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review states plainly that "There was no advisory committee meeting for this submission," and the Office Director memo explains the Division decided not to take the application to an AdComm because the molecule was not novel and there were no efficacy or safety concerns creating controversy over approvability. Because no committee was held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
